decision.observation: 10 mph, gear 1, timer 55:04.354, red X lit, dots pale. The car has drifted onto the grass at the left edge of the gravel, with the Oil banner and a large pine to its left; the road is a wide ribbon running up-frame and bending left across the top of the frame, the lake at top-right. White marker posts line both edges and one lies on the grass ahead-left.
decision.hypothesis: The car is only half a car width off the gravel's left edge, so a short right steer should put it back on the surface before the left bend arrives.
decision.memory: The 0.9 s plain-W beat at 6 mph gained to 10 mph but again drifted left toward the fence/banner side - on this stretch plain W alone consistently pulls left. Correct with a brief D, then steer A for the bend.
